title: Certificate Renewals Booked by Harborline Support
content:
**Support desk service entry: SSL/TLS Certificates.** This entry covers renewals of SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions that Harborline support books for the customer during a conversation.

## 1. Scope

1.1 A renewal that Harborline support books for the customer during a conversation is a support renewal. Only a support renewal is priced under this rule.

1.2 Every renewal bought in the dashboard remains under the base renewal rule. That rule extends the subscription from its end date by 1 to 3 years (3 years being the longest subscription of every product), never from the payment date. It bills the tier's price for the years renewed plus the extra names for those years, reduced by the account tier's SSL discount percentage and rounded half up to the cent.

1.3 The volume ladder never applies to any renewal.

1.4 Every auto-renew charge that falls due is priced under the auto-renew charge rule, whatever pays it, and account credit pays it first, following the account charter: where the account credit balance on the day the charge falls due covers that amount in full, the account's credit run books it at that amount from account credit, and otherwise it is charged in full to the default card on file at that amount and booked under the auto-renew charge rule.

## 2. What a support renewal does

2.1 A support renewal adds one year to the subscription. The year runs from the subscription end date, never from the payment date.

2.2 A support renewal books one renewal line, of charge type renewal and for one year, in the subscription's certificate billing history. The line's period starts on the previous subscription end date. The subscription end date moves one calendar year later.

## 3. Payment

3.1 The account holder pays a support renewal personally at Harborline's secure checkout, by a card or PayPal account entered there, once the agent has quoted the amount. Harborline support never takes the payment details itself.

3.2 The holder may choose account credit instead. Where the credit balance covers the whole charge, the account's credit run books the renewal, and the renewal is not booked under this rule.

## 4. Invocation: `renew_certificate_subscription_0365c0e5`

**Situation of use and capability.** This tool is for the account holder's own checkout payment of a quoted one-year renewal. One call bills one renewal line on the subscription. The line is of charge type renewal, for one year, paid with the card or PayPal account the holder enters at checkout, and has a newly issued Harborline order number. The call also moves the subscription end date one calendar year later, counted from the current end date. The amount is billed exactly as given.

**How it is invoked.** The tool belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it as a customer-side tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves completes the payment at checkout.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | the reference number of the certificate subscription being renewed, as the agent reads it out from the certificate subscription lookup | text id |
| `checkout_method` | how the holder pays at checkout | `card` when the holder enters a payment card at checkout; `paypal` when the holder pays with a PayPal account at checkout |
| `amount` | the renewal amount quoted by the agent | USD, 2 decimal places, signed, positive for this charge; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A successful call returns a confirmation sentence. It names the new renewal line's reference number, the order number (HL- followed by 8 digits), the amount billed in US dollars with two decimals and the payment method recorded (card or paypal). It also gives the covered period as two dates in YYYY-MM-DD form (the prior end date and the new end date) and the subscription's new end date. The presence of the new end date means the renewal was paid.

The tool returns these errors:
- "Error: the renewal amount must be a positive dollar figure." when the amount is not positive.
- "Error: checkout_method must be card or paypal." when another method is given.
- "Error: no certificate subscription" followed by the reference, when no such subscription exists.
